components.name: GPU Chip (Graphics Processing Unit)
components.reasoning: The core semiconductor device performing graphics and compute processing, this is the fundamental and inseparable primary component of any discrete GPU card.

components.name: GDDR Memory Modules
components.reasoning: Typically separate DRAM chips mounted on the card, providing the high-speed video memory necessary for GPU operations; these are procured from specialized memory suppliers and are distinct from the GPU chip.

components.name: Printed Circuit Board (PCB)
components.reasoning: The multi-layer circuit board onto which the GPU, memory, and other components are mounted; it has a distinct manufacturing process and separate supply chain.

components.name: VRM (Voltage Regulator Module) / Power Delivery System
components.reasoning: Power management modules including MOSFETs, controllers, and inductors integrated into a subassembly or distinct board, procured separately or assembled as a module to ensure stable GPU and memory power supply.

components.name: Cooling Solution (Heatsink with Fans or Liquid Cooling Block)
components.reasoning: Critical for thermal management, these assembled cooling subsystems are usually manufactured or sourced as distinct units that include heat spreaders, fans, or liquid cooling blocks.

components.name: Video Output Interfaces (Display Connectors and Supporting Circuitry)
components.reasoning: Port assemblies such as HDMI, DisplayPort connectors, along with supporting controller boards, are procured as modules or assemblies separate from the main PCB and GPU chip.

components.name: Memory Controller and Interface Circuitry (integrated on PCB)
components.reasoning: While sometimes integrated within the GPU chip, some discrete controller components or supporting chips on the PCB may be separate, but generally considered part of the PCB assembly.

components.name: Backplate / Structural Frame
components.reasoning: Mechanical and protective subassembly, often procured separately to provide rigidity and protection; not always present but common especially in higher-end models.

phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Discrete computer graphics processing unit (GPU) card featuring a dedicated GPU chip fabricated on advanced semiconductor nodes, combined with high-bandwidth GDDR memory, power delivery, and cooling solutions.
phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: Discrete GPUs dominate the high-performance graphics and computing market segment due to their dedicated processing power and specialized memory subsystems, making this configuration the industry standard for gaming, workstation, and AI applications as of 2024-2025.

components.name: GPU Semiconductor Die (Graphics Chip)
components.reasoning: The core processing element, the GPU die is the fundamental chip performing graphics computation and is always present as a major component distinctly manufactured and sourced from specialized semiconductor fabs.

components.name: Printed Circuit Board (PCB)
components.reasoning: The multi-layer PCB serves as the physical platform mounting the GPU die, VRAM, VRMs, and other components, providing electrical interconnections and mechanical support; it is a distinct manufactured and procurable assembly.

components.name: Video Memory Modules (GDDR6 or GDDR6X)
components.reasoning: High-speed VRAM chips (usually GDDR6 or GDDR6X) are separately packaged memory modules mounted on the PCB, essential for GPU operation and procured as distinct components.

components.name: Voltage Regulator Module (VRM)
components.reasoning: A set of power management circuits delivered as discrete components or as subassemblies on the PCB, responsible for regulating power to the GPU and memory; often modular and sourced separately.

components.name: Cooling Assembly (Heatsink and Fans)
components.reasoning: A large mechanical and thermal subassembly consisting of metal heatsinks, heat pipes, and one or multiple fans, procured as a manufactured unit to provide thermal management for the GPU card.

components.name: Thermal Interface Material (TIM)
components.reasoning: While essential, TIM such as thermal paste or pads is sometimes included within the cooling assembly as part of the subcomponents, but it can be considered a separate component procured in bulk by OEMs.

components.name: Backplate
components.reasoning: Structural support and protection for the PCB, often manufactured as a separate aluminum or steel plate component attached to the card assembly, but presence varies by model and manufacturer.

components.name: Output Interface Connectors (DisplayPorts, HDMI)
components.reasoning: Physical connectors mounted on the PCB providing video output signals to external displays; these are standard distinct components mounted on graphics cards.

components.name: Soldered Electronic Components (Capacitors, Resistors, Inductors)
components.reasoning: Common to all PCBs but these components are numerous and considered subparts of the PCB assembly rather than distinct major components on their own.

phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Discrete graphics processing unit (GPU) graphics card assembly with dedicated cooling solution and PCB.
phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: The dominant form of GPUs for computer graphics processing is the discrete graphics card assembly, which includes the GPU semiconductor die mounted on a multi-layer PCB along with dedicated VRAM modules and a cooling system.
